label: Material footprint (raw material extraction total)
head: Material
explanation: All raw materials extracted from nature (biomass, metal ores, non-metallic minerals, fossil fuels), measured in tonnes at the point of extraction. The footprint version is also called Raw Material Consumption (RMC).

label: Biomass
head: Material
explanation: Harvested crops, crop residues, grazed biomass, timber and fish.

label: Metal ores
head: Material
explanation: Extracted metal ores (gross ore, e.g. iron, copper, bauxite, gold ores).

label: Non-metallic minerals
head: Material
explanation: Sand, gravel, limestone, clays and other minerals, mostly used for construction.

label: Fossil fuels (as materials)
head: Material
explanation: Extracted coal, crude oil, natural gas and peat, measured in tonnes.

label: Greenhouse gases (GWP100; EDGAR)
head: Emissions (EDGAR)
explanation: All Kyoto greenhouse gases (CO2, CH4, N2O, F-gases) weighted with their 100-year global warming potential. Based on the EDGAR emission inventory. Recommended default for carbon footprints.

label: Greenhouse gases (GWP100; OECD)
head: Emissions (OECD)
explanation: Same as above, but based on the OECD emission data. Differences to EDGAR show data uncertainty.

label: CO2 from fossil fuels and industry (EDGAR)
head: Emissions (EDGAR)
explanation: Carbon dioxide from burning fossil fuels and industrial processes such as cement production (excluding short-cycle biogenic carbon).

label: CO2 short-cycle biogenic (EDGAR)
head: Emissions (EDGAR)
explanation: Carbon dioxide from burning biomass (short carbon cycle). Usually NOT counted in greenhouse gas totals.

label: Methane CH4 (EDGAR)
head: Emissions (EDGAR)
explanation: Methane, mainly from livestock, rice, landfills and fossil fuel extraction. Mass of the gas, not weighted by warming potential.

label: Nitrous oxide N2O (EDGAR)
head: Emissions (EDGAR)
explanation: Nitrous oxide, mainly from fertilised soils and manure. Mass of the gas, not weighted by warming potential.

label: Fine particulate matter PM2.5 (EDGAR)
head: Emissions (EDGAR)
explanation: Particles smaller than 2.5 micrometres from biomass and fossil combustion. Main air pollutant affecting human health.

label: Sulphur dioxide SO2 (EDGAR)
head: Emissions (EDGAR)
explanation: Sulphur dioxide, mainly from burning coal and oil. Causes acid rain and respiratory problems.

label: Nitrogen oxides NOx (EDGAR)
head: Emissions (EDGAR)
explanation: Nitrogen oxides from combustion (traffic, power plants). Contributes to smog and fine particles.

label: Ammonia NH3 (EDGAR)
head: Emissions (EDGAR)
explanation: Ammonia, mainly from agriculture (manure, fertiliser). Contributes to fine particles and nitrogen pollution.

label: Health damage from emissions (all pollutants)
head: Emissions disease burden (EDGAR)
explanation: Disability-adjusted life years: years of healthy life lost due to illness or premature death caused by emissions.

label: Land use (total)
head: Land use
explanation: Land occupied for crops, pastures, forestry and urban areas.

label: Cropland (annual and permanent crops)
head: Land use
explanation: Area used for annual crops (e.g. cereals) and permanent crops (e.g. fruit trees, coffee, oil palm).

label: Pastures
head: Land use
explanation: Area used for grazing livestock.

label: Forestry (intensive and extensive)
head: Land use
explanation: Forest area used for wood production.

label: Urban land
head: Land use
explanation: Built-up land (settlements, infrastructure).

label: Primary energy use (total)
head: Energy
explanation: Energy taken from nature: coal, oil, gas, nuclear, biofuels and captured renewable energy (hydro, wind, solar), in terajoules.

label: Fossil primary energy
head: Energy
explanation: Primary energy from coal, peat, oil and natural gas.

label: Nuclear primary energy
head: Energy
explanation: Primary energy from nuclear power.

label: Renewable primary energy (biofuels and captured energy)
head: Energy
explanation: Solid biofuels plus captured energy (hydro, wind, solar, geothermal).

label: Employment (total)
head: Employment
explanation: Number of people employed (headcount).

label: Employment (female)
head: Employment
explanation: Number of women employed.

label: Employment (male)
head: Employment
explanation: Number of men employed.

label: Employment (high skill)
head: Employment skill
explanation: People employed in high-skill occupations.

label: Employment (middle skill)
head: Employment skill
explanation: People employed in middle-skill occupations.

label: Employment (low skill)
head: Employment skill
explanation: People employed in low-skill occupations.

label: Blue water consumption
head: Blue_water_consumption
explanation: Surface and groundwater withdrawn and not returned (e.g. evaporated in irrigation).

label: Water stress (scarcity-weighted water use)
head: Water_stress
explanation: Blue water consumption weighted by the local water scarcity. Water used in dry regions counts more.

label: Nitrogen leaching to freshwater (FAO)
head: Freshwater N leaching (FAO)
explanation: Nitrogen from fertiliser and manure washed into rivers and lakes; causes algal blooms (eutrophication). New in GLORIA v60.

label: Biodiversity loss from land use
head: Biodiversity_loss
explanation: Potentially disappeared fraction of species due to land use (global species loss indicator).

label: Value added (total)
head: VALUE_ADDED
pattern: ^(Compensation|Taxes|Subsidies|Net operating surplus|Net mixed income|Consumption of fixed capital)
explanation: Income generated in production: wages, profits, depreciation and net production taxes. Sum over all industries equals GDP. Use this for Trade in Value Added (TiVA).

label: Compensation of employees
head: VALUE_ADDED
explanation: Wages, salaries and social contributions paid to employees.

label: Operating surplus and mixed income
head: VALUE_ADDED
explanation: Profits of companies and income of self-employed (net of depreciation).

label: Consumption of fixed capital
head: VALUE_ADDED
explanation: Depreciation of buildings, machinery and other capital goods.

label: Net taxes on production
head: VALUE_ADDED
explanation: Taxes on production minus subsidies on production.
